summary: Three snowbike riders caught in a hard-slab avalanche in the South Fork of Dickson Creek east of Red and White Mountain; one partially buried and self-extricated, the other two fully buried and killed.
location: South Fork of Dickson Creek, east of Red and White Mountain
notes: CAIC preliminary (quoted in SnowBrains): Saturday Feb 15, 2020; 3 motorized snowbike riders caught; persistent weak layer, 3-4 ft crown; one partially buried and self-extricated, two carried into a gully, fully buried and killed. Survivor rode to a Vail Backcountry Tours yurt; staff alerted Vail Mountain Rescue and Eagle County 911; VMR recovered the bodies on Feb 16.
